items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: I met him a couple of times, I could tell right off the bat, I said he was a phony

ctx.x: He was the MC at, that, that, uh, at the, uh, uh, Saga Theater, and my brother Jules' band worked with him, and that's the band that, uh, went, went to New York, see, and he gave him that big talk, you know, fast talk, I don't know whether you know, know Landry well, I met him a couple of times, I could tell right off the bat, I said he was a phony, you know what I mean?
